    "is_sm_ips_ports": "binary"
  },
  "constraints": [
    {
      "id": "R1",
      "category": "definition",
      "alternatives": [
        "(df['dur'] > 0) & np.isclose(df['sload'], df['sbytes'] * 8 / df['dur'], rtol=1e-5, atol=1e-8) | (df['dur'] == 0) & (df['sload'] == 0)",
        "(df['dur'] > 0) & np.isclose(df['sload'], df['sbytes'] / df['dur'], rtol=1e-5, atol=1e-8) | (df['dur'] == 0) & (df['sload'] == 0)",
        "(df['dur'] > 0) & np.isclose(df['sload'], df['sbytes'] * 8 / df['dur'], rtol=1e-5, atol=1e-8)",
        "(df['dur'] > 0) & np.isclose(df['sload'], df['sbytes'] / df['dur'], rtol=1e-5, atol=1e-8)"
      ],
      "features": ["sload", "sbytes", "dur"],
      "rationale": "Sload is documented as source bits per second, so it should be sbytes*8/dur; alternative bytes per second also plausible."
    },
    {
      "id": "R2",
      "category": "definition",
      "alternatives": [
        "(df['dur'] > 0) & np.isclose(df['dload'], df['dbytes'] * 8 / df['dur'], rtol=1e-5, atol=1e-8) | (df['dur'] == 0) & (df['dload'] == 0)",
        "(df['dur'] > 0) & np.isclose(df['dload'], df['dbytes'] / df['dur'], rtol=1e-5, atol=1e-8) | (df['dur'] == 0) & (df['dload'] == 0)",
        "(df['dur'] > 0) & np.isclose(df['dload'], df['dbytes'] * 8 / df['dur'], rtol=1e-5, atol=1e-8)",
        "(df['dur'] > 0) & np.isclose(df['dload'], df['dbytes'] / df['dur'], rtol=1e-5, atol=1e-8)"
      ],
      "features": ["dload", "dbytes", "dur"],
      "rationale": "Dload is documented as destination bits per second, so it should be dbytes*8/dur; alternative bytes per second also plausible."
    },
    {
      "id": "R3",
      "category": "definition",
      "alternatives": [
        "(df['spkts'] > 0) & (df['smean'] == df['sbytes'] // df['spkts']) | (df['spkts'] == 0) & (df['smean'] == 0)",
        "(df['spkts'] > 0) & (df['smean'] == np.floor(df['sbytes'] / df['spkts'])) | (df['spkts'] == 0) & (df['smean'] == 0)",
        "(df['spkts'] > 0) & (df['smean'] == np.round(df['sbytes'] / df['spkts'])) | (df['spkts'] == 0) & (df['smean'] == 0)"
      ],
      "features": ["smean", "sbytes", "spkts"],
      "rationale": "smean is mean packet size from source, defined as total source bytes divided by source packet count; integer division or rounding plausible."
    },
    {
      "id": "R4",
      "category": "definition",
      "alternatives": [
        "(df['dpkts'] > 0) & (df['dmean'] == df['dbytes'] // df['dpkts']) | (df['dpkts'] == 0) & (df['dmean'] == 0)",
        "(df['dpkts'] > 0) & (df['dmean'] == np.floor(df['dbytes'] / df['dpkts'])) | (df['dpkts'] == 0) & (df['dmean'] == 0)",
        "(df['dpkts'] > 0) & (df['dmean'] == np.round(df['dbytes'] / df['dpkts'])) | (df['dpkts'] == 0) & (df['dmean'] == 0)"
      ],
      "features": ["dmean", "dbytes", "dpkts"],
      "rationale": "dmean is mean packet size from destination, defined as total destination bytes divided by destination packet count; integer division or rounding plausible."
    },
    {
      "id": "R5",
      "category": "definition",
      "alternatives": [
        "np.isclose(df['tcprtt'], df['synack'] + df['ackdat'], rtol=1e-5, atol=1e-8)"
      ],
      "features": ["tcprtt", "synack", "ackdat"],
      "rationale": "tcprtt is documented as the sum of synack and ackdat."
    },
    {
      "id": "R6",
      "category": "definition",
      "alternatives": [
        "(df['dur'] > 0) & np.isclose(df['rate'], (df['spkts'] + df['dpkts']) / df['dur'], rtol=1e-5, atol=1e-8) | (df['dur'] == 0) & (df['rate'] == 0)",
        "(df['dur'] > 0) & np.isclose(df['rate'], (df['sbytes'] + df['dbytes']) / df['dur'], rtol=1e-5, atol=1e-8) | (df['dur'] == 0) & (df['rate'] == 0)",
        "(df['dur'] > 0) & np.isclose(df['rate'], (df['sbytes'] + df['dbytes']) * 8 / df['dur'], rtol=1e-5, atol=1e-8) | (df['dur'] == 0) & (df['rate'] == 0)",
        "(df['dur'] > 0) & np.isclose(df['rate'], df['spkts'] / df['dur'], rtol=1e-5, atol=1e-8) | (df['dur'] == 0) & (df['rate'] == 0)",
        "(df['dur'] > 0) & np.isclose(df['rate'], df['dpkts'] / df['dur'], rtol=1e-5, atol=1e-8) | (df['dur'] == 0) & (df['rate'] == 0)",
        "(df['dur'] > 0) & np.isclose(df['rate'], df['sbytes'] / df['dur'], rtol=1e-5, atol=1e-8) | (df['dur'] == 0) & (df['rate'] == 0)",
        "(df['dur'] > 0) & np.isclose(df['rate'], df['dbytes'] / df['dur'], rtol=1e-5, atol=1e-8) | (df['dur'] == 0) & (df['rate'] == 0)"
      ],
      "features": ["rate", "spkts", "dpkts", "sbytes", "dbytes", "dur"],
      "rationale": "rate is undocumented; plausible definitions include packets per second, bytes per second, or bits per second based on total or directional counts."
    }
  ]
}
